title: PolarScale: A Physics-Grounded Benchmark for Radiometrically Consistent RGB-to-Stokes Estimation
title_zh: PolarScale: 一个基于物理的基准，用于辐射一致的 RGB 到斯托克斯估计

paragraphs.en: Polarization imaging provides physical cues beyond intensity imaging but typically requires specialized hardware. Recent methods infer polarization from RGB-like inputs, yet predict only normalized Stokes components or relative descriptors, from which the radiometric scale needed for full Stokes reconstruction has been divided out. We introduce PolarScale , a benchmark that makes this scale an explicit prediction and evaluation target. Built on existing trichromatic full-Stokes measurements, PolarScale takes the per-scene normalized total-intensity image s 0 \mathrm{s}_{0} (a scene-referred linear image, not a consumer sRGB photograph) and asks models to predict normalized Stokes components, AoLP/DoLP/DoCP, and a per-scene scale. Because the scale is divided out of the input, it is not physically identifiable; PolarScale therefore evaluates dataset-conditioned semantic scale estimation against a constant-scale control, together with angular, self-consistency, and physical-bound metrics. Across seven restoration-based and generative backbones and three prediction strategies, the strongest restoration models estimate the scale with 3.6–4.3% mean relative error versus 5.7% for the constant control and violate physical bounds on fewer than 0.25% of pixels, whereas two generative baselines collapse to a near-zero scale; explicit descriptor supervision improves descriptor accuracy (23.66 vs. 18.88 dB PSNR for MAE). Predicted full-Stokes representations improve diffuse/specular separation, material segmentation, and glare classification, although in diffuse/specular separation the learned scale performs only on par with the constant control.
paragraphs.zh: 偏振成像除了强度成像之外还能提供物理线索，但通常需要专用硬件。 近期方法从类RGB输入中推断偏振信息，但仅预测归一化的斯托克斯分量或相对描述符，而完整斯托克斯重建所需的辐射度量标度已被除去了。 我们提出了 PolarScale，一个将该标度作为显式预测与评估目标的基准数据集。 PolarScale 基于现有的三原色全斯托克斯测量数据，以每场景的归一化总强度图像 s₀ \mathrm{s}_{0}（一个场景相关的线性图像，而非消费级 sRGB 照片）为输入，要求模型预测归一化的斯托克斯分量、AoLP/DoLP/DoCP 以及每场景的标度。 由于该标度已从输入中除出，因此无法通过物理方式确定；为此，PolarScale 将数据集相关的语义标度估计与恒定标度控制方案进行比较评估，并结合角度、自一致性和物理边界指标进行检验。 在七种基于恢复和生成模型的主干网络以及三种预测策略中，性能最强的恢复模型对标度的平均相对误差为 3.6–4.3%，而恒定标度控制方案的误差为 5.7%，且违反物理边界的像素比例低于 0.25%；相比之下，两种生成基线模型则退化到接近零的标度；显式描述符监督提升了描述符的准确性（MAE 的 PSNR 从 18.88 dB 提升至 23.66 dB）。 预测出的全斯托克斯表示能够改善漫反射/镜面反射分离、材料分割和眩光分类，尽管在漫反射/镜面反射分离任务中，所学习的标度表现仅与恒定标度控制方案相当。

paragraphs.en: Polarization imaging captures scene properties by measuring the polarization state of light, which is not observable with conventional RGB sensing. This additional polarization information provides cues about physical surface characteristics such as birefringence, surface stress, and micro-scale roughness. As a result, polarization imaging has enabled progress in challenging vision tasks, including reflection separation [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] , material recognition [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] , and shadow removal [ 9 ] , complementing RGB-based region understanding [ 10 , 11 ] and semantic segmentation [ 12 ] . Beyond vision, polarization is also a key degree of freedom in photonic hardware, where the polarization state of lasers can encode binary spins for photonic Ising computing [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 偏振成像通过测量光的偏振状态来捕捉场景特性，而这些特性是传统 RGB 传感无法观测到的。 这种额外的偏振信息提供了有关物理表面特性的线索，例如双折射、表面应力和微观粗糙度。 因此，偏振成像推动了具有挑战性的视觉任务的进展，包括反射分离 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ]、材料识别 [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] 和阴影去除 [ 9 ]，从而补充了基于 RGB 的区域理解 [ 10 , 11 ] 和语义分割 [ 12 ]。 除了视觉领域，偏振也是光子硬件中的一个关键自由度，其中激光的偏振状态可以编码二进制自旋，用于光子伊辛计算 [ 13 , 14 , 15 ]。

paragraphs.en: However, acquiring polarization data typically requires dedicated polarization-sensitive hardware such as integrated linear polarizers and retarders [ 16 , 17 ] , and even controlling polarization at the source requires careful device engineering, such as engineered mesa geometries and integrated metasurfaces in polarization-controlled lasers [ 18 , 19 ] . These systems increase sensor cost, reduce spatial resolution due to multiplexed designs, complicate calibration, and are difficult to integrate into large-scale or mobile vision platforms. Recovering absolute, radiometrically scaled Stokes vectors is more demanding still, since it additionally requires radiometric calibration of the polarimetric system. In practical deployment scenarios, such as robotics, autonomous systems, consumer imaging, and wearable sensing [ 20 ] , these constraints significantly limit the accessibility and scalability of polarization imaging.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，获取偏振数据通常需要专用的偏振敏感硬件，例如集成线性偏振器和延迟器 [ 16 , 17 ]；甚至在光源处控制偏振也需要精密的器件设计，例如在偏振可控激光器中采用的工程化 mesa 几何结构和集成超表面 [ 18 , 19 ]。 这些系统会提高传感器成本，因多路复用设计而降低空间分辨率，使校准过程更加复杂，并且难以集成到大规模或移动视觉平台中。 恢复绝对且经过辐射度缩放的斯托克斯向量则更具挑战性，因为这还需要对偏振测量系统进行辐射度校准。 在实际部署场景中，例如机器人技术、自主系统、消费级成像和可穿戴传感 [ 20 ]，这些限制显著制约了偏振成像的可及性和可扩展性。

paragraphs.en: To overcome these barriers, recent methods infer polarization information directly from RGB-like images using neural networks [ 21 , 22 ] . However, these approaches predict normalized Stokes components or relative polarimetric descriptors (Figure 1 ), from which the radiometric scale has been divided out. Such outputs describe relative polarimetric structure but cannot be turned into absolute Stokes vectors, which radiance-level applications require. For example, polarization-based diffuse/specular separation attributes the polarized radiance to the specular component [ 23 , 24 , 1 ] , and glare depends on the amount of polarized light reaching the sensor rather than on the fraction of light that is polarized. Whether such absolute quantities can be estimated from intensity images has not yet been measured.
paragraphs.zh: 为了克服这些障碍，近期方法利用神经网络直接从类 RGB 图像中推断偏振信息 [21, 22]。 然而，这些方法预测的是归一化的斯托克斯分量或相对偏振描述符（图 1），其中辐射度量标度已被排除在外。 这类输出描述了相对偏振结构，但无法转化为绝对斯托克斯向量，而辐射度级别的应用需要后者。 例如，基于偏振的漫反射/镜面反射分离方法将偏振辐射归因于镜面成分 [23, 24, 1]，而眩光则取决于到达传感器的偏振光量，而非偏振光的比例。 目前尚未验证是否可以从强度图像中估算出这类绝对量。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduce PolarScale , a benchmark that makes the radiometric scale an explicit prediction and evaluation target. PolarScale is built on the trichromatic full-Stokes measurements of the Spectral-Polarization dataset [ 16 ] . Its input is the normalized total-intensity image s 0 = S 0 / σ \mathrm{s}_{0}=\mathrm{S}_{0}/\sigma , a scene-referred linear intensity image rather than a consumer sRGB photograph; we keep the name “RGB-to-Stokes” established by [ 22 ] for continuity. Models predict the normalized Stokes components { s 1 , s 2 , s 3 } \{\mathrm{s}_{1},\mathrm{s}_{2},\mathrm{s}_{3}\} , the descriptors AoLP, DoLP, and DoCP, and the per-scene scale σ \sigma , from which the full Stokes components follow as S n = σ ​ s n \mathrm{S}_{n}=\sigma\,\mathrm{s}_{n} . Because σ \sigma is divided out of the input, it cannot be recovered by physical inversion; as in metric monocular depth estimation, it can only be inferred from scene content. PolarScale therefore measures dataset-conditioned semantic scale estimation , and, like diagnostic benchmarks that isolate specific failure modes rather than report only aggregate scores [ 25 ] , we evaluate it accordingly: scale errors are scored against a constant-scale control, and wrap-aware angular, Stokes self-consistency, and physical-bound metrics complement standard image-quality scores.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 PolarScale——一个将辐射度量标度作为明确预测与评估目标的基准。 PolarScale 基于 Spectral-Polarization 数据集 [16] 中的三原色全斯托克斯测量数据构建。 其输入是归一化的总强度图像 s₀ = S₀ / σ，即一个场景相关的线性强度图像，而非消费级 sRGB 照片；为保持延续性，我们沿用了 [22] 中确立的“RGB-to-Stokes”这一名称。 模型可预测归一化的斯托克斯分量 {s₁, s₂, s₃}、描述符 AoLP、DoLP 和 DoCP，以及每个场景的标度 σ，由此可推导出完整的斯托克斯分量 Sₙ = σ·sₙ。 由于 σ 已从输入中被除去，因此无法通过物理反演恢复；与度量单目深度估计类似，它只能从场景内容中推断出来。 因此，PolarScale 衡量的是受数据集条件约束的语义标度估计能力；与那些仅报告汇总分数而非隔离特定失败模式的诊断性基准不同 [25]，我们据此进行评估：标度误差通过与恒定标度对照进行评分，同时结合考虑环绕的角向一致性、斯托克斯自一致性和物理边界指标，以补充标准图像质量分数。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarking seven restoration-based and generative backbones under three prediction strategies (direct, joint, and decoupled), we find that the strongest restoration models estimate the scale better than the constant control and nearly satisfy physical bounds, whereas two generative baselines collapse to a near-zero scale, and that full-Stokes PSNR is a poor measure of scale recovery. Three downstream probes show that predicted full-Stokes representations are useful, while scale-attribution controls show that the contribution of the learned scale itself is mixed, identifying scale accuracy as the open problem PolarScale is designed to track.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三种预测策略（直接、联合和解耦）下对七种基于恢复和生成模型的基础架构进行了基准测试，发现最强的恢复模型能比恒定控制更好地估计尺度，且几乎满足物理边界；而两种生成基线模型则退化到接近零的尺度。此外，全斯托克斯 PSNR 并非衡量尺度恢复能力的有效指标。 三项下游探针表明，预测出的全斯托克斯表示是有用的；而尺度归因控制则显示，所学习尺度本身的贡献是混合的，这凸显出尺度准确性正是 PolarScale 旨在追踪的开放问题。

paragraphs.en: Task reformulation: PolarScale makes the radiometric scale an explicit prediction and evaluation target of RGB-to-Stokes estimation, and states its input modality and identifiability scope explicitly.

paragraphs.en: Physics-aware evaluation protocol: we score scale estimation against a constant-scale control and add wrap-aware AoLP angular error, Stokes self-consistency, and physical-bound violation metrics. All of them ship in a standalone benchmark package with the preprocessed splits, scale values, derived targets, evaluation scripts, and a datasheet.

paragraphs.en: Recent methods infer polarization information directly from RGB inputs [ 22 , 21 ] . A recent benchmark [ 22 ] establishes a standardized protocol for predicting normalized Stokes components from RGB images, while PolarAnything [ 21 ] introduces a diffusion-based framework for polarimetric image synthesis. Methodologically, existing approaches can be broadly grouped into restoration-based regression and generative image translation. Restoration-based methods formulate polarization inference as deterministic pixel-wise prediction, using architectures such as Restormer [ 31 ] , Uformer [ 32 ] , and MAE [ 33 ] . Generative methods instead model polarization inference as conditional synthesis, using diffusion-based models such as WDiff [ 34 ] , DiT [ 35 ] , RealFill [ 36 ] , and I2ITurbo [ 37 ] . These methods are formulated and evaluated on normalized Stokes components or relative descriptors, so the radiometric scale is never predicted or scored. Table 1 summarizes how PolarScale differs: it is built on the existing measurements of [ 16 ] rather than on a new capture, and its contribution lies in what is predicted and evaluated.

paragraphs.en: Polarization provides complementary cues beyond RGB imaging for material, reflection, and geometry analysis. Because reflected polarization varies with surface properties such as roughness and coating, it has been used for material classification and object recognition [ 4 ] . Polarization also separates diffuse and specular reflection [ 23 , 1 ] , suppresses specular reflections, and enhances transparent or translucent objects [ 38 ] . In geometry estimation, polarization depends on surface orientation and therefore supports surface normal estimation and Shape-from-Polarization reconstruction [ 39 ] , complementing intensity-based 3D reconstruction and weather-generalized monocular depth estimation [ 40 ] , whose robustness under degraded capture conditions such as raindrops is itself an active benchmarking topic [ 41 ] . Beyond these tasks, polarization has also been used for reflectance and appearance modeling [ 42 , 43 , 44 ] , semantic segmentation [ 45 ] , sparse sensing [ 46 ] , and wearable robotics [ 47 ] , and polarization switching in lasers enables drive-efficient GHz-rate binary-state updates [ 48 ] and all-optical annealing [ 49 ] . Tasks that operate on polarized radiance, such as reflection separation, need absolute rather than normalized Stokes information (Section 4.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 偏振光为材料、反射和几何分析提供了超越RGB成像的互补性线索。 由于反射偏振光会随表面特性（如粗糙度和涂层）而变化，因此它已被用于材料分类和物体识别 [ 4 ] 。 偏振光还能区分漫反射和镜面反射 [ 23 , 1 ] ，抑制镜面反射，并增强对透明或半透明物体的识别效果 [ 38 ] 。 在几何估计中，偏振光取决于表面朝向，因此能够支持表面法线估计和“偏振光形状重建” [ 39 ] ，从而补充基于强度的三维重建和适用于各种天气的单目深度估计 [ 40 ] ；而后者在雨滴等劣化采集条件下的鲁棒性本身也是一个活跃的基准测试主题 [ 41 ] 。 除了这些任务，偏振光还被用于反射率和外观建模 [ 42 , 43 , 44 ] 、语义分割 [ 45 ] 、稀疏感知 [ 46 ] 和可穿戴机器人技术 [ 47 ] ；此外，激光器中的偏振切换还能实现驱动高效的GHz速率二进制状态更新 [ 48 ] 和全光学退火 [ 49 ] 。 处理偏振辐射量的任务（如反射分离）需要绝对斯托克斯参数信息，而非归一化后的斯托克斯信息（第4.5节）。

paragraphs.en: DoLP quantifies the proportion of linearly polarized light, whereas DoCP reflects the contribution of circular polarization. AoLP describes the orientation of the polarization ellipse; it lies in [ − 90 ∘ , 90 ∘ ] [-90^{\circ},90^{\circ}] and is periodic with period 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} , so its errors must be measured with wrap-around (Section 3.4 ). All three descriptors are ratios of Stokes components and are therefore invariant to the radiometric scale.
paragraphs.zh: DoLP 量化了线偏振光的比例，而 DoCP 则反映了圆偏振的贡献。 AoLP 描述了偏振椭圆方向；其取值范围在 [ − 90 ∘ , 90 ∘ ] [-90^{\circ},90^{\circ}] 之间，并以 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} 为周期循环，因此必须通过环绕处理来测量其误差（第 3.4 节）。 这三个描述符均为斯托克斯分量的比值，因此不受辐射度标度的影响。

paragraphs.en: Because s 0 \mathrm{s}_{0} is normalized by the per-scene σ \sigma (Eq. ( 4 )), σ \sigma has been divided out of the input and is not identifiable by physical inversion : a globally rescaled scene produces the same input. Since the input is linear rather than display-referred, the ambiguity is a single global factor with no tone-mapping component. The scale remains learnable only through p ⁡ ( σ ∣ scene content ) p(\sigma\mid\text{scene content}) , because absolute radiance correlates with content such as the illumination type and the indoor/outdoor context; metric monocular depth estimation is ambiguous in the same way and is likewise learned from semantic priors [ 57 , 58 ] , and evaluating models on targets that are underdetermined by their inputs is an emerging benchmarking theme in its own right [ 59 ] . PolarScale therefore evaluates dataset-conditioned semantic scale estimation rather than the recovery of radiometric information contained in the input. Every scale result must accordingly be read against a constant-scale control that predicts the training prior (Section 3.4 ), and the scale distribution of the source data bounds what the benchmark can measure (Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 由于 s₀（即 \mathrm{s}_{0}）已通过每场景的 σ（即 \sigma，见公式 (4)）进行了归一化，因此 σ 已被从输入中除出，无法通过物理反演确定：一个全局重新缩放的场景会产生相同的输入。由于输入是线性的而非显示相关的，这种模糊性表现为一个单一的全局因子，而不包含色调映射成分。该缩放比例仅能通过 p⁡(σ∣scene content)（即 p(\sigma\mid\text{scene content})）进行学习，因为绝对辐射亮度与场景内容相关，例如光照类型以及室内/室外上下文；度量单目深度估计也存在同样的模糊性，并且同样是从语义先验中学习的 [57, 58]。此外，在输入信息不足以确定目标的情况下对模型进行评估，本身已成为一种新兴的基准测试主题 [59]。因此，PolarScale 评估的是数据集条件化的语义缩放比例估计，而非恢复输入中包含的辐射度量信息。据此，每个缩放结果都必须与一个预测训练先验的恒定缩放对照（见第 3.4 节）进行比较，而源数据的缩放分布则限定了该基准能够测量的范围（见第 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: PolarScale is built on the Spectral-Polarization dataset [ 16 ] , which provides 2,022 trichromatic and 311 hyperspectral full-Stokes images of real-world scenes. The trichromatic Stokes images have a resolution of 2100 × 1920 2100\times 1920 and are captured in a single shot by a division-of-focal-plane RGB full-Stokes polarimeter with on-sensor quarter-wave plates and linear polarizers [ 17 ] , so they include the circular component S 3 \mathrm{S}_{3} . Each scene carries labels for its environment (indoor or outdoor), illumination (clear or cloudy sunlight, white or incandescent light), capture time, and type (object- or scene-oriented). We use the trichromatic subset, whose full-Stokes measurements retain the radiometric scale needed to define σ \sigma . Appendix B gives further details.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the restoration-based methods Restormer [ 31 ] , Uformer [ 32 ] , and MAE [ 33 ] , and the generative methods WDiff [ 34 ] , DiT [ 35 ] , RealFill [ 36 ] , and I2ITurbo [ 37 ] , each under the three strategies of Section 3.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了基于修复的方法 Restormer [ 31 ]、Uformer [ 32 ] 和 MAE [ 33 ]，以及生成式方法 WDiff [ 34 ]、DiT [ 35 ]、RealFill [ 36 ] 和 I2ITurbo [ 37 ]，每种方法均在第 3.3 节的三种策略下进行了测试。

paragraphs.en: The restoration models, WDiff, and DiT use native multi-channel regression heads whose output matches the strategy (10 channels for (a), 19 for (b) and (c)); for (c) we add a second decoder branch for the descriptors. For RealFill and I2ITurbo, changing the output dimensionality would disturb the pre-trained weights that are their main strength, so we steer them with task-specific text prompts (e.g., "S1" , "Scale" , "AoLP" ) and, for (c), with two independent sets of LoRA parameters. Their inference uses one pass per component, so every model predicts the same components exactly once. Appendix C gives the full per-strategy details.
paragraphs.zh: 恢复模型、WDiff 和 DiT 使用原生多通道回归头，其输出与策略相匹配（(a) 为 10 个通道，(b) 和 (c) 为 19 个通道）；对于 (c)，我们为描述符添加了一个第二个解码器分支。 对于 RealFill 和 I2ITurbo，改变输出维度会破坏其预训练权重——而这正是它们的主要优势，因此我们通过任务特定的文本提示（例如，“S1”、“Scale”、“AoLP”）来引导它们；对于 (c)，则使用两组独立的 LoRA 参数。 它们的推理过程每个组件仅执行一次遍历，因此每个模型都恰好对相同的组件进行一次预测。 附录 C 提供了每种策略的完整细节。

paragraphs.en: MAE and Uformer clearly beat the constant- σ \sigma floor (3.6% and 4.3% mean relative error versus 5.7%), and Restormer and I2ITurbo beat it more narrowly (5.1% and 5.3%). RealFill, DiT, and WDiff fall well below the floor: DiT and WDiff collapse to a near-zero σ ^ \hat{\sigma} , which is non-positive in 97 and 11 of the 200 scenes, while RealFill settles on a large over-estimate. MAE’s estimate is not merely a re-learned constant: the deviation of its σ ^ \hat{\sigma} from the training prior correlates with the ground-truth deviation ( r = 0.43 r=0.43 ), indicating a content-to-scale mapping beyond the dataset average. However, on scenes whose σ \sigma departs strongly from the prior, the models regress toward it, as expected for dataset-conditioned scale estimation.
paragraphs.zh: MAE 和 Uformer 明显优于恒定 σ 的基准（平均相对误差分别为 3.6% 和 4.3%，而基准为 5.7%），Restormer 和 I2ITurbo 的优势则较小（分别为 5.1% 和 5.3%）。 RealFill、DiT 和 WDiff 的表现远低于该基准：DiT 和 WDiff 的 σ^ 几乎降至零，在 200 个场景中有 97 个和 11 个场景为非正值，而 RealFill 则给出了较大的高估值。 MAE 的估计结果并非简单地重新学习了一个常数：其 σ^ 与训练先验的偏差与真实值的偏差存在相关性（r = 0.43），表明其内容到尺度的映射超越了数据集的平均水平。 然而，在 σ 与先验值存在显著偏离的场景中，这些模型会回归到先验值，这与基于数据集的条件尺度估计的预期一致。

paragraphs.en: The constant-scale control (Appendix D , Table 8 ) shows that full-Stokes PSNR barely depends on whether the scale is learned. Replacing MAE’s learned σ ^ \hat{\sigma} by the training median changes its full-Stokes PSNR from 21.08 to 21.13 dB, and the training mean, whose scale error is about three times larger (16.2%), yields an even higher PSNR for every model. With a fixed peak value, PSNR on S n \mathrm{S}_{n} is dominated by the normalized structure and rewards shrinking the reconstruction. The control also exposes the opposite failure: WDiff’s collapsed σ ^ \hat{\sigma} shrinks its reconstructions and inflates its full-Stokes PSNR, which falls from 18.30 to 2.65 dB once an honest constant scale is applied. We therefore do not interpret the gap between normalized and full-Stokes PSNR in Table 2 as evidence about scale recovery, and use the scale metrics of Table 3 as the primary scale measures.

paragraphs.en: Under our adaptation protocols, the evaluated restoration backbones outperform the evaluated generative ones on normalized-Stokes and descriptor accuracy (Table 2 ) and on scale estimation and physical consistency (Table 3 ). The generative baselines show two distinct failure modes: WDiff and DiT, which use native regression heads, collapse the scale toward zero, and RealFill over-estimates it. I2ITurbo is the exception on scale (5.3% error, comparable to Restormer), but it trails on physical consistency. Retraining RealFill and I2ITurbo with native multi-channel heads that predict all seven outputs in one pass (Appendix C , Table 7 ) proved the weaker adaptation: I2ITurbo’s scale error rises from 5.3% to 8.8%, and RealFill’s native head collapses the scale ( σ ^ ≤ 0 \hat{\sigma}\leq 0 in 21 of 200 scenes; r = − 0.07 r=-0.07 with the true scale); the only gain is self-consistency from single-pass prediction (I2ITurbo: 27.4 ∘ 27.4^{\circ} versus 52.4 ∘ 52.4^{\circ} ). We therefore limit this conclusion to the evaluated architectures and adaptation protocols rather than claiming a paradigm-level gap.

paragraphs.en: We run three probes of whether predicted absolute Stokes information is useful beyond reconstruction quality (Table 5 ; protocols in Appendix E ). (i) Diffuse/specular separation. Following the classical polarization-based separation [ 23 , 1 ] , the polarized part of the reflected radiance is attributed to the specular component and the unpolarized remainder to the diffuse component, both in absolute radiance. A baseline regresses the six absolute channels (diffuse and specular RGB) directly, whereas we compose them analytically from the predicted s ^ n \hat{\mathrm{s}}_{n} and a scale; holding s ^ n \hat{\mathrm{s}}_{n} fixed, we vary the scale source (shuffled across scenes, constant training median, learned σ ^ \hat{\sigma} , or ground truth as an upper bound) to attribute its effect. (ii) Material segmentation on MCubeS [ 6 ] , whose 20 classes are annotated independently of polarization: a base input without polarization is augmented with different predicted polarization representations. (iii) Glare-level classification. Glare is an inherently absolute quantity: it depends on the amount of polarized light reaching the sensor, not on the fraction of light that is polarized. Each test scene receives a glare level from the absolute polarized radiance of its ground-truth Stokes vectors, which is predicted either from image appearance alone or from the predicted absolute Stokes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了三项探究，以判断预测的绝对斯托克斯信息是否在重建质量之外仍有价值（表 5；协议见附录 E）。 (i) 漫反射/镜面反射分离。 遵循经典的基于偏振的分离方法 [23, 1]，反射辐射度的偏振部分被归因于镜面反射分量，而非偏振的剩余部分则归因于漫反射分量，两者均以绝对辐射度表示。 基线模型直接回归六个绝对通道（漫反射和镜面反射的 RGB），而我们从预测的 s^n \hat{\mathrm{s}}_{n} 和一个比例因子出发，通过解析方式合成这些通道；在保持 s^n \hat{\mathrm{s}}_{n} 固定的情况下，我们通过改变比例因子的来源（跨场景打乱、训练时的恒定中位数、学习得到的 σ^ \hat{\sigma}，或作为上限的真实值）来探究其影响。 (ii) 在 MCubeS [6] 上的材质分割，其 20 个类别的标注独立于偏振：一个无偏振的基础输入被增强了不同的预测偏振表示。 (iii) 眩光等级分类。 眩光本质上是一个绝对量：它取决于到达传感器的偏振光总量，而非偏振光的比例。 每个测试场景根据其真实斯托克斯向量的绝对偏振辐射度获得一个眩光等级，该辐射度要么仅从图像外观预测，要么从预测的绝对斯托克斯向量预测。

paragraphs.en: The predicted full-Stokes representation improves all three tasks over the tested RGB or relative-polarization baselines: diffuse/specular AbsRel drops from 0.190/0.508 to 0.118/0.445, mIoU rises from 0.330 with predicted DoLP/AoLP to 0.374, and glare accuracy over the 200 test scenes rises from 48.5% (Wilson 95% interval [ 60 ] [41.7, 55.4]) with image appearance to 63.0% ([56.1, 69.4]) with predicted absolute Stokes. The contribution of the learned scale itself is mixed. In diffuse/specular separation, the learned σ ^ \hat{\sigma} performs on par with the constant control (0.118/0.445 versus 0.118/0.448) and thus does not consistently beat the dataset prior, whereas the ground-truth scale gives a clear improvement (0.100/0.440) and a shuffled scale degrades the diffuse estimate (0.133): an accurate absolute scale matters, but current estimates are not yet accurate enough to exploit it. In material segmentation, adding σ ^ \hat{\sigma} to the predicted normalized Stokes raises mIoU from 0.355 to 0.374, but without constant- or shuffled-scale variants this does not uniquely isolate the per-scene scale; the glare probe has no scale control. Our claim is therefore that predicted full-Stokes representations benefit the evaluated tasks, with the absolute scale as one contributing component whose accuracy remains the main open problem.

sents.zh: 在漫反射/镜面反射分离任务中，所学习的 σ ^ \hat{\sigma} 的表现与恒定标度控制相当（0.118/0.445 对比 0.118/0.448），因此并未稳定优于数据集先验；而真实标度则带来了明显提升（0.100/0.440），打乱的标度则会降低漫反射估计值（0.133）：准确的绝对标度确实重要，但当前的估计结果尚不足以有效利用它。

sents.en: In material segmentation, adding σ ^ \hat{\sigma} to the predicted normalized Stokes raises mIoU from 0.355 to 0.374, but without constant- or shuffled-scale variants this does not uniquely isolate the per-scene scale; the glare probe has no scale control.
sents.zh: 在材料分割任务中，将 σ ^ \hat{\sigma} 加入预测的归一化斯托克斯可将 mIoU 从 0.355 提升至 0.374；但若没有恒定标度或打乱标度的变体，则无法单独确定场景特定的标度影响；而眩光探测任务中则未设置标度控制。

sents.en: Our claim is therefore that predicted full-Stokes representations benefit the evaluated tasks, with the absolute scale as one contributing component whose accuracy remains the main open problem.
sents.zh: 因此，我们的结论是：预测的全斯托克斯表示有助于所评估的各项任务，其中绝对标度是一个贡献因素，但其准确性仍是当前亟待解决的主要问题。

paragraphs.en: Because σ \sigma is divided out of the input, PolarScale measures dataset-conditioned semantic scale estimation; predicted scales and reconstructed S n \mathrm{S}_{n} are not calibrated radiometry, and models regress toward the training prior on scenes whose scale departs strongly from it.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 σ \sigma 已从输入中被除出，PolarScale 衡量的是数据集条件化的语义尺度估计；预测的尺度和重建的 S n \mathrm{S}_{n} 并非经过校准的辐射度量，对于其尺度与训练先验存在显著偏离的场景，模型会向该训练先验进行回归。

paragraphs.en: PolarScale may benefit polarization-aware perception in robotics, material analysis, remote sensing, 3D reconstruction [ 68 ] , image completion [ 69 ] and computational imaging by reducing reliance on specialized hardware, with medical image segmentation [ 70 ] and whole-slide classification [ 71 ] as further applications to investigate, and lightweight estimators could eventually run on emerging photonic accelerators for convolutional networks [ 72 ] . Its main risk is over-reliance on inferred polarization in safety-critical settings such as driver assistance: predicted scales are dataset-conditioned estimates, not measurements, and should be validated under the target sensor, lighting, and domain before high-stakes use. The benchmark is not designed for person identification or surveillance.
paragraphs.zh: PolarScale 可通过减少对专用硬件的依赖，为机器人技术、材料分析、遥感、三维重建 [ 68 ]、图像补全 [ 69 ] 和计算成像中的偏振感知带来益处；医学图像分割 [ 70 ] 和整张切片分类 [ 71 ] 是待进一步研究的应用方向，而轻量级估计器最终或许能在新兴的光子卷积加速器上运行 [ 72 ]。 其主要风险在于对推断出的偏振信息的过度依赖，尤其是在驾驶员辅助系统等安全性要求极高的场景下：预测的标度值是基于数据集的条件性估计，而非实际测量值，因此在高风险使用前，应在目标传感器、光照条件和实际应用领域进行验证。 该基准测试并非为人员识别或监控而设计。

paragraphs.en: We introduced PolarScale , a benchmark that makes the radiometric scale an explicit target of RGB-to-Stokes estimation and, because the scale is divided out of the input, evaluates dataset-conditioned scale estimation against a constant-scale control together with angular, self-consistency, and physical-bound metrics. The strongest evaluated restoration models beat the dataset prior and nearly satisfy physical bounds, two generative baselines collapse the scale, and explicit descriptor supervision with decoupled decoding gives the most balanced predictions. Predicted full-Stokes representations benefit three downstream tasks, while the learned scale is not yet accurate enough to consistently beat the prior; PolarScale makes this gap measurable for future physically grounded RGB-to-Stokes models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 PolarScale，一个基准测试，它将辐射度量标度明确地作为 RGB 到斯托克斯估计的目标；由于该标度已从输入中分离出来，因此该测试将数据集相关的标度估计与恒定标度控制一同评估，并结合了角度、自一致性和物理边界等指标。 评估中表现最强的恢复模型优于数据集先验，并几乎满足物理边界；两种生成式基线模型则导致标度坍缩；而通过解耦解码实现的显式描述符监督则产生了最均衡的预测结果。 预测出的完整斯托克斯表示对三个下游任务有益，但所学习的标度目前尚不够精确以持续优于先验；PolarScale 使这一差距变得可测量，为未来基于物理原理的 RGB 到斯托克斯模型提供了改进方向。

paragraphs.en: The Spectral-Polarization dataset [ 16 ] contains 2,022 trichromatic Stokes images ( 2100 × 1920 × 3 × 4 2100\times 1920\times 3\times 4 ) and 311 hyperspectral Stokes images ( 612 × 512 × 21 × 4 612\times 512\times 21\times 4 , 450–650 nm in 10 nm steps). The trichromatic images are captured in a single shot by a division-of-focal-plane RGB full-Stokes polarimeter with on-sensor quarter-wave plates and linear polarizers [ 17 ] ; the hyperspectral images are captured by scanning a liquid-crystal tunable filter and rotating a quarter-wave plate. Every image is labeled with its environment (indoor/outdoor), illumination (clear or cloudy sunlight, white or incandescent light), capture time, and scene type (object- or scene-oriented). PolarScale uses only the trichromatic subset.

paragraphs.en: Type (a), direct Stokes estimation. The output tensor is 𝐏 ∈ ℝ H × W × 10 \mathbf{P}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 10} , concatenating { s 1 , s 2 , s 3 } ∈ ℝ H × W × 9 \{\mathrm{s}_{1},\mathrm{s}_{2},\mathrm{s}_{3}\}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 9} and the scale map σ ∈ ℝ H × W × 1 \sigma\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 1} . For the restoration-based methods, WDiff, and DiT, we set the dimensionality of the final output layer to 10. For RealFill and I2ITurbo, we use task-specific text prompts ( "S1" , "S2" , "S3" , "Scale" ) with image-polarization pairs to guide training and steer inference. Type (b), joint estimation. The output tensor is 𝐏 ∈ ℝ H × W × 19 \mathbf{P}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 19} , adding AoLP, DoLP, and DoCP; RealFill and I2ITurbo receive the additional prompts "AoLP" , "DoLP" , and "DoCP" . Type (c), decoupled multi-decoder estimation. For the restoration-based methods, WDiff, and DiT, we add a second decoder branch: the original one estimates scale-dependent parameters and the new one scale-independent parameters. For RealFill and I2ITurbo, we use two independent sets of LoRA parameters instead of an additional decoder, which avoids the parameter redundancy and overhead of extra frozen decoder layers.

paragraphs.en: To test whether prompt-based adaptation disadvantaged the pre-trained generative baselines, we also trained them with native conditioning. paragraphs.zh: 为了测试基于提示词的适应方法是否对预训练生成基线模型不利，我们还使用原生条件化对这些模型进行了训练。 文本编码器被冻结且接收一个空提示词，所有七个输出通过加宽的层在一次前向传播中联合预测（RealFill：conv_in 9 → 33 9\rightarrow 33 和 conv_out 4 → 28 4\rightarrow 28 通道；I2ITurbo：conv_out 4 → 28 4\rightarrow 28 通道），并通过复制预训练权重进行初始化。 除此之外，训练方案保持不变（相同的 LoRA 秩、优化器、学习率、批量大小和分辨率）。 表 7 显示，原生条件化是较弱的适应方法。

paragraphs.en: Reference diffuse and specular components are computed from the measured full Stokes vectors of the 200 test scenes by the same polarization-based separation, in absolute radiance. Our setting composes both components analytically from s ^ n \hat{\mathrm{s}}_{n} and a scale; the RGB-direct baseline regresses the six absolute channels directly. For the shuffled-scale control, the learned scales are permuted across test scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 参考漫反射和镜面反射分量通过相同的偏振基分离方法，从 200 个测试场景的测量全斯托克斯向量中计算得出，并以绝对辐射亮度表示。 我们的设置通过 s ^ n \hat{\mathrm{s}}_{n} 和一个比例因子对两个分量进行解析合成；RGB-direct 基线则直接回归六个绝对通道。 对于打乱比例因子的对照组，已学习到的比例因子会在不同测试场景之间进行置换。

paragraphs.en: The 200 scenes are the benchmark’s held-out test split, and their glare levels are computed from the ground-truth polarization of those same scenes; no component of this probe is re-fit, so there is no variation across training seeds or split resampling. sents.zh: 这项工作不涉及人类受试者，且数据中不包含对人员或其他敏感个人数据的标注。

sents.en: Outdoor scenes may incidentally show vehicles or bystanders, as in the source dataset [ 16 ] .
sents.zh: 户外场景可能偶然出现车辆或旁观者，例如在源数据集 [ 16 ] 中。

sents.en: All data are used solely for research purposes.
sents.zh: 所有数据仅用于研究目的。

paragraphs.en: All experiments are performed on a server with eight NVIDIA RTX A5000 GPUs (24 GB memory each); training takes about one day per restoration model and two days per diffusion-based model. The code, pre-trained checkpoints, configuration files, and the benchmark package are publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PolarScale .
paragraphs.zh: 所有实验均在配备八块 NVIDIA RTX A5000 GPU（每块内存为 24 GB）的服务器上执行；每个恢复模型的训练大约需要一天时间，而基于扩散的模型则需要两天。 代码、预训练检查点、配置文件以及基准测试包可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PolarScale 公开获取。
